summary: Deep Sea Minerals Corp. (formerly Copperhead Resources Inc.), a Canadian mineral explorer, filed a Form 6-K with unaudited interim financials and MD&A for Q2 2026. The filing shows a cash balance of C$1.64M, a net loss of C$2.78M, and significant operating expenses including advertising and stock-based compensation. No special-situation transaction is disclosed; it is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer with no acquisition, divestiture, or similar event.
